---
title: "Organized Crime"
toc: true
---

Organized crime can be treated as illicit coordination under weak legal enforceability: groups govern exchange, maintain discipline, and adapt to enforcement.

## Mechanisms to connect

- reputation and internal discipline
- violence as governance
- corruption and protection
- network resilience

## Models to try

- network games
- repeated-game enforcement
- principal-agent problems in illicit organizations
